contexts.text: Ornate dwellings with their furniture (an allowable pleasure).
They live in palaces, the useful forms of which are resplendent with gold and precious stones...
Tables on which were various things for use of precious stones, and of entire gems in heavenly forms.
I saw their house furniture, all of which was in heavenly forms, and glittered with gold as it were flaming with interstudded rubies.
He saw the decorations of the gates, etc. of the palace, and especially those of the furniture...
Spirits... dwell in houses... adorned with furniture of every kind...
In the ideas of some Spirits are articles of furniture...
In the Heavens... there are palaces... which contain furniture of every kind.
When Spirits are provided with furniture, they rarely reflect on the source...
To the same are given houses full of furniture and decorations according to the uses...
The Truths of faith have been compared to the decorations and furniture in palaces...
They know how to decorate their places with various pieces of furniture; but only for some moments; for when the phantasy ceases, the appearances cease.
God 4. 12. In the Spiritual World... the furniture of a house is created in a moment.
